scope: Actual About clicks in Simple/Advanced; attribution/tool/asset wording and unchanged document/history. Static repository/sample audit; no licensing or redistribution authorization granted.
ui_probe_source:
extends "res://tests/shortcut_editor_smoke.gd"
func named_button(node: Node,text: String) -> Button:
	if node is Button and node.text==text:return node
	for child in node.get_children():
		var found:=named_button(child,text)
		if found:return found
	return null
func run() -> void:
	var folder: String=OS.get_cmdline_user_args()[0]
	app=load("res://main.tscn").instantiate();app.display_prefs_path=folder.path_join("prefs.cfg");app.recovery_root=folder.path_join("recovery");app.recent_path=folder.path_join("recent.json");root.add_child(app);await settle();app.home.hide();app.autosave_enabled.button_pressed=false
	var keys: Array=app.keys.duplicate(true);var world: Dictionary=app.current_world().duplicate(true);var history: int=app.history.size();var dirty: bool=app.dirty
	for advanced in [false,true]:
		app.set_advanced(advanced);await settle();var entry:=named_button(app,"About")
		check(entry!=null and entry.is_visible_in_tree(),"About is available at current UI detail")
		await click(entry);var dialog: AcceptDialog
		for child in app.get_children():
			if child is AcceptDialog and child.title=="Credits / open source notices":dialog=child
		check(dialog!=null and dialog.visible,"actual About click opens notices")
		check(dialog.dialog_text.contains("Godot Engine 4.6") and dialog.dialog_text.contains("MIT") and dialog.dialog_text.contains("godotengine.org/license/") and dialog.dialog_text.contains("ffmpeg.org/legal.html") and dialog.dialog_text.contains("License and codec options depend on the installed build") and dialog.dialog_text.contains("Imported asset rights must be verified"),"visible notices preserve attribution without inventing tool or asset licenses")
		await click(dialog.get_ok_button());await settle()
		check(app.keys==keys and app.current_world()==world and app.history.size()==history and app.dirty==dirty,"notices leave the current scene and history unchanged")
	print("NOTICES_CURRENT ",JSON.stringify({"checks":checks,"failures":failures}));app.free();quit(0 if failures==0 else 1)
limits: App distribution license undecided; no installer/release/binary/native asset redistribution performed. Source attribution retained; unknown imported rights remain unknown.
